purpose: Verify forward/backward, optimizer, adapter save, SFT export and DPO reference wiring; not model quality.

stages.output: isolated smoke SFT merge; never label as formal final SFT

stages.reference: adapter-disabled implicit reference on smoke SFT

acceptance: Exactly global_step=3 for both training stages
Finite loss and gradients, optimizer actually runs
Adapter tensors finite and artifacts present
SFT merge succeeds before DPO starts
DPO points to freshly merged smoke SFT, never historical SFT
No automatic promotion to full training
execution_gate: Training pipeline must consume a separate hash-bound smoke authorization; do not delete the unconditional guard without replacing it.
